title: Allow correcting a completed/cancelled task record's own bookkeeping without reopening it
objective: The owner observed this session that agent-task-guard.mjs's blanket denial of any write to a completed/cancelled task record made it impossible to fix a task closed with status set before its validations/artifacts were filled in (happened four times this session). Owner-directed fix: allow a write to a completed/cancelled task record only when the resulting status and owner are byte-identical to what is already on disk (a same-agent correction of its own already-accurate closure), and continue denying any write that changes status or owner (reopening or reassigning a closed task for new work stays blocked).
validations: node --test tools/scripts/agent-task-guard.test.mjs: 16/16 passed, including 2 new tests (allows a same-status/same-owner correction via both Edit and Write; still rejects any write that changes status or owner on a closed record)
pnpm run ai:check: coordination validation passed with 34 task records
git diff --check: passed (only pre-existing LF/CRLF checkout warnings)

Real-world dogfood: this exact edit (adding validations after a separate status='completed' edit) was denied by the pre-change guard four times earlier this session; after this fix it was allowed because status and owner stayed unchanged
risks: This changes the runtime coordination guard's PreToolUse behavior; per root AGENTS.md this class of change normally requires a separate task and explicit owner approval -- present here as the owner's direct in-conversation instruction.

The Edit-tool branch of the new logic simulates the edit (old_string/new_string replacement) to inspect the resulting JSON before deciding, since the real Edit tool does not receive full post-edit content in its hook input; this is an approximation of the real Edit tool's matching semantics, not a byte-perfect replica, and errs toward denial when the simulation cannot parse.
Per DEC-053/ADR-0015, this task prepares uncommitted changes only; the repository owner reviews and creates the actual Git commit.
